description: React component for setting up multi-factor authentication (MFA) in Mattermost, including generating MFA secrets, displaying QR code, and handling user input for MFA code submission.

classes.name: Setup
classes.description: React component class for MFA setup, managing MFA secret generation, QR code display, and MFA code validation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state and input reference.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Generates MFA secret on component mount if user is eligible.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates MFA code, and activates MFA.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders MFA setup form with QR code, secret, and input for MFA code.
